title: lychnis coeli-rosa var. aspera
intro: Lychnis coeli-rosa var. aspera, commonly known as rough sky poppy, is a species of flowering plant in the family Caryophyllaceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly for its ability to treat various health issues, such as fever, cough, and respiratory problems. The health benefits of Lychnis coeli-rosa var. aspera include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms and promote recovery. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which exert therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
